title: License Status Inquiry
claims: The page heading is License Status Inquiry.
The tool describes retrieving license details, including enforcement actions, for an insurance agent, broker, adjuster, bail agent, and agency or organization.
The tool offers License Number search, Individual Name Search, Business Name Search, and Enforcement Actions lookup.
The current public address of this CDI service is https://cdicloud.insurance.ca.gov/cal.
updateCadence: Live database; results reflect CDI records as of the moment of the query.
